headline: Study: US data centers rival states and countries in power use
summary: A new Harvard study finds US hyperscale data centers consume electricity comparable to an entire US state or a midsized country, accounting for roughly 2% of total US electricity, with fossil fuels still the dominant power source for these facilities.

claims.statement: A new study finds US hyperscale data centers consume electricity on the scale of entire US states or midsized countries.
